key_points: Oracle and Wipro expand partnership into cloud-based drug safety services (pharmacovigilance).
Multiple bullish analyses label Oracle as an undervalued AI opportunity with up to 50% upside potential.
Insider filing shows a modest sale of 2,631 shares, a minor negative signal.
Reports highlight concerns about layoffs and debt stress from Project Jupiter weighing on sentiment.
Media commentary is mixed: Cramer and others are bullish, while some analysts question growth sustainability.
